profile.name: PLC限位到限位插入式运动机构
profile.description: 一种由PLC控制的简单一维插入/退出运动机构，在两个机械限位之间运动，用于将部件插入或移出实验位置或光路。此类装置常用于束线或实验站中的简单定位、联锁演示和运动控制测试。
profile.description_en: A simple PLC-controlled one-dimensional in/out motion device that travels between two mechanical limit positions. It is used to insert or retract a component from an experimental position or beam path, commonly for basic positioning, interlock demonstrations, and motion-control testing in beamline or laboratory setups.

registry.name: Example L2 L
registry.description: Example L2 L是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, all pvnames等操作。
